research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ambient.ai is researching systems and methods for correlating access-system primitives with semantic primitives from sensor data, as described in Systems and methods for machine learning enhanced intelligent building access. They are also developing approaches for classifying contextual events as threats, detailed in Systems and methods for machine learning-based site-specific threat modeling. These efforts focus on AI-driven analysis and threat detection using existing camera and sensor infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: Ambient.ai provides a security platform that applies AI to existing camera infrastructure to sensor and prevent incidents.

product.name: Ambient.ai Agentic Physical Security Platform
product.description: A unified physical security platform that adds AI-based monitoring, threat assessment, response, access-control correlation, and investigations to existing cameras, sensors, VMS, and access-control systems.

product.name: Ambient Foundation
product.description: The base platform for continuous, real-time situational awareness across enterprise camera, access-control, and sensor infrastructure.

product.name: Ambient Threat Detection
product.description: A real-time threat detection and assessment product that identifies contextual security events across more than 150 validated threat signatures.

product.name: Ambient Advanced Forensics
product.description: An AI-powered investigation product that searches video by language, appearance, and license plate to reconstruct incidents more quickly.

product.name: Ambient Access Intelligence
product.description: An access-control monitoring product that correlates physical access alarms with nearby video to validate events and reduce false alarms.
